# cashForecast13/

13-week cash forecast (cash13). Product rulings: Hein 2026-11-16. Route `GET /api/accounting/cash-forecast-13` → `getCashForecast13(companyId, appToday())`.

## Engine (PURE: no `@/lib/neon`, no clock)
- `engine.ts` `runEngine(EngineInput): CashForecast13`. Order: known items → budget fill → manual items → overrides (array order).
- `weeks.ts`: 13 Monday–Sunday weeks, week 1 holds today. `weekIndexOf`: a date before today → week 1; after the last Sunday → null (left out, `beyond_horizon` warning).
- `lines.ts`: items fold into one line per `lineKey`; `sortLines` makes output independent of reader row order. `toCents` for every rand → cents.
- `budgetFill.ts` (M1): per month and category, budget × (in-horizon days from today ÷ month days) FIRST, then − known in that month (by EFFECTIVE date), floored at 0, spread over those in-horizon days (cumulative rounding). Never subtract before prorating. It subtracts the GROSS known (`EngineInput.budgetKnown`, before credit netting; N1), so credit already in the bank is not refilled. Lines `budget:<category>`, kind `estimate`.
- `adjustments.ts`: manual items → `manual:<id>` (past = done: a repeat drops past occurrences; a one-off dated before this week's Monday is NOT forecast and is listed in a `manual_item_past` warning (description, date, amount; at most 20, oldest first, then "and N more"); one dated earlier this week is week 1). SAME-SIGN manual items (a receipt in `customer_receipts`, a payment in `supplier_payments`) count as KNOWN for the budget fill, by their in-horizon occurrences' months; a refund (the opposite sign) is never known, it sits on top of the fill; overrides never edit a source line: deltas go on `override:<lineKey>` (kind `override`). set/add amounts arrive SIGNED in the line's sign; a move_to amount is a MAGNITUDE (≥ 0, null = whole cell) applied in the cell's sign and clamped to the cell (never flips it); a move from an empty cell is skipped (L-a). A bad override is skipped with `override_skipped`. `engineAdapter.ts` imports `ManualItem` / `Override` / `PayDay` and uses `lines.toCents` (one rand→cents).
- Pure source rules: `arExpected.ts` (due / history = due + median days late with ≥3 paid in 12 months / no_history = week 1; disputes excluded; `overdueSummary` over the netted items: inside 13 weeks vs `beyondHorizonCents`), `creditNetting.ts` (unapplied credit per entity, earliest EXPECTED DATE first — deliberately, the conservative reading (L-b) — never below 0; AR leftover then nets that customer's recurring receipts (L-c); only the rest → `credit_unused`), `fx.ts` (foreign doc × its stored rate; no rate → left out, `currency_not_converted`), `loanPlan.ts`, `payDates.ts` (`payDateOf`, `backToFriday`), `recurringItems.ts` (`advanceDate`; a passed run is invoiced today).

## Invariants (tests/unit/services/cashForecast13)
- Integer cents everywhere (`assertCents` throws). Per week: opening + Σ lines = closing; next opening = closing. Line total = Σ weekly.

## Readers (SQL, read-only, every query company-scoped)
- `cashForecast13Service.ts` runs each source in `guardedSource` (own savepoint): a SQLSTATE error, or a domain refusal on the source's explicit allow-list (`refusalOf`: `BUDGET_REFUSALS`, `LOAN_REFUSALS`), → `source_unavailable` warning; anything else propagates. Sequential, never `Promise.all`. Opening cash unreadable → `CashForecastUnavailableError` (route 503), never a zero opening.
- `readReceivables.ts`: `fetchARAgingInvoices` / `fetchAPAgingInvoices` (today, today) → fx → date → net `getUnappliedByEntity` credit (M2). A document is foreign when either currency column names another than `companies.functional_currency`. Paid date: D4.
- `readPayroll.ts` (L3): only `run_kind = 'regular'` AND `pay_frequency = 'monthly'` runs (approved/paid); any other frequency → `payroll_frequency_unsupported`, never guessed. Pay dates from today use that month's own run net, else the latest run's. A pay date before today is ASSUMED PAID — an ASSUMPTION (lead, 2026-11-16): nothing in the app sets `payroll_run_headers.status = 'paid'` or `paid_at` today, so an approved run past its pay date cannot be told from a paid one; revisit if a mark-paid writer lands. Recent ones listed in `payroll_past_assumed_paid`. statutory = max(0, PAYE − ETI) + UIF + SDL.
- `readSars.ts` + `readVat.ts` (H1): `getComplianceCalendarWithMarks`; completed items excluded; `marksUnavailable` / `submissionsUnavailable` → warnings. A payment DUE BEFORE TODAY, or a refund whose ARRIVAL date is before today (L-d), is ASSUMED PAID/RECEIVED (in opening cash): never a line, listed with its amount in `sars_past_due_assumed_paid`. EMP201 `generateEMP201().totalDeductions`; VAT box 11 (closed), accrued + budget pro rata (open), budget only (future); refund (box 11 < 0) is an inflow at period end + `refundLagMonths`, last day of month. IRP6 only from a primary budget's `taxEvents` in the due month.
- `readBudget.ts`: flag `budgets_three_way` (`hasFeature`), `getThreeWay` per FY the horizon touches, each in a savepoint; typed three-way refusals → warning, not a crash.
- `readLoans.ts` (L2, L6): `previewSchedule` per active loan (own savepoint, `LOAN_REFUSALS`) less `loan_payments` (`loanPlan.ts`: by `period_number`, else by amount within the payment's month). No payments recorded → past instalments assumed paid, `loan_payments_not_recorded`; with payments, an unsettled past instalment after the first payment and within 60 days → week 1, `loan_overdue`; older → assumed paid, listed (period, amount) in `loan_payments_not_recorded` (L-e). A foreign-currency loan has no rate → left out. `readRecurring.ts`: D1.

## Rulings on the sources (lead, 2026-11-16; do not change without a new ruling)
- D1 Recurring receipts are dated by the RUNNER's terms (customer terms, else the company default via `dueDateWithDefault`). Never read `recurring_invoices.payment_terms`: the runner ignores it.
- D2 The route is a cookie GET: `withAuth(withErrorHandler)` + `checkReportRateLimit(companyId, 'cash-forecast-13')`, like the other report routes. No bearer/`read:reports` variant.
- D3 Disputed AR (`disputedAmount`) is out of receipts and shown in `overdueAR.disputedCents`, as the aging leaves it out of its buckets.
- D4 AR paid date = the agingRewind datable-settlement date: MAX(`customer_payments.payment_date`) over allocations, receipts not draft/cancelled. Credit-note-only and undated legacy settlements do not count toward the 3-invoice history.

## Stored inputs (PR 2, migration 999i)
- AR lines: ONE per customer, key `ar:<customerId>` (no basis in the key, so an override stays on its line as invoices age). The line's `basisCents: { due, history, no_history }` splits its in-horizon cents; each item keeps its own `basis`. AP lines are `ap:<supplierId>`.
- `getCashForecast13` reads the stored manual items, overrides and salary pay day through `readStoredInputs` (each its own guarded source; unreadable = a `source_unavailable` warning, none / none / day 25). Options the caller passes win over the stored ones.
- `engineAdapter.ts` converts stored rows (rand, dates, `direction`) to `ManualItem` / `Override` / `PayDay`; the store, routes and rules are documented in `pages/api/accounting/cash-forecast-13/.claude.md`.
